assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_68fa04c0b41e700.text: I was interested in how people wasted time and why they didn't work hard at their jobs.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: If you want to sell online,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 如果你想在线销售，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: you should start by making sure that the website doesn't look messy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 首先要确保网站看起来不杂乱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: If you don't have the skills to make it look neat,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 如果你没有让它看起来整洁的技能，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: hire a professional web designer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 就雇一位专业网页设计师。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: You want a neat,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 你需要一个整洁、

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: clean website.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 干净的网站。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: It isn't something you want to be careless with.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 这不是可以粗心对待的事。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: I see.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 我明白了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: Well, I would like to have a lot of black on the website.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 嗯，我想让网站用很多黑色。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: I think that colour is professional and serious looking.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 我觉得这种颜色看起来专业又严肃。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: I understand,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 我理解，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: but I think if you want to make the website attractive,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 但我认为如果你想让网站吸引人，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: it needs more colour.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 它需要更多颜色。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: More colour could help the design pop out a bit more and prevent customers from leaving the website before buying anything.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 更多颜色能让设计更突出，也能避免顾客买东西前就离开网站。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: Aha,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 啊哈，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: that's a good idea.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 这是个好主意。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: I actually like blue too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 其实我也喜欢蓝色。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: I think someone else told me about colours people prefer,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 我觉得别人还告诉过我人们喜欢哪些颜色，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: but I forgot.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 但我忘了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: Yes, it's easy to forget to think about something as simple as colour.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 是的，人很容易忘记考虑像颜色这么简单的事。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.text: The web designer you hire might have some good ideas about which colours to use.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d089bb8560c7631.zh: 你雇的网页设计师可能会对该用哪些颜色有好建议。
